steps.code:
# Fetch all liked songs (paginate through all pages)
liked_songs = []
page_index = 0
page_limit = 20
while True:
    page = apis.spotify.show_liked_songs(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit)
    if isinstance(page, dict) and 'message' in page:
        print("Error fetching liked songs:", page)
        break
    liked_songs.extend(page)
    if len(page) < page_limit:
        break
    page_index += 1

liked_song_ids = set(song['song_id'] for song in liked_songs)
print("Total liked songs:", len(liked_song_ids))
print("Liked song IDs:", liked_song_ids)

steps.code:
# Check current song and advance until we hit a liked song
current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
print("Current song:", current)

max_steps = 20
steps = 0
while current['song_id'] not in liked_song_ids and steps < max_steps:
    next_resp = apis.spotify.next_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Next song response:", next_resp)
    current = apis.spotify.show_current_song(access_token=access_token)
    print("Now current song:", current)
    steps += 1

if current['song_id'] in liked_song_ids:
    print("Found liked song:", current['title'], "ID:", current['song_id'])
    apis.supervisor.complete_task(answer=current['title'])
else:
    print("Did not find liked song within steps")
